sasha: heads-up, i'm drafting the docs release notes & changelog for tomorrow's deploy. need quick eyes on whatsnew bullets, sdk snippets, curl examples, and a short known-issues list.
ben: which PRs are we including?
sasha: include #5102 (whatsnew copy), #5107 (embedding examples), #5115 (sdk snippets + streaming fixes), #5118 (redirects).
olivia: i spotted a mismatch: curl examples use `embed_model` but JS/py examples use `model`. we should standardize the param and add a redirect for the old path.
noah: for the whatsnew, product asked for bullets with 1-2 sentences each + CTA link. simple, customer-facing.
courtney: i'll rewrite the whatsnew bullets and add links. i can also fix the curl snippets.
ben: quick patch for python streaming sample (old snippet assumed chunk.text):
```python
# updated streaming sample (publishable)
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
for event in client.generate_stream(model="kestrel", prompt="Hello"):
    # token events carry incremental text in `delta`
    if event.get("type") == "token":
        print(event.get("delta", ""), end="")
    elif event.get("type") == "done":
        print("\n-- stream complete --")
```
sasha: add a comment above noting streaming may include control events and chunk shapes changed vs older clients. good.
olivia: also flag embedding param name in curl and provide canonical curl snippet we can paste in the whatsnew: 
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-medium","input":"your text"}'
```
noah: known-issue suggestion: "Embeddings from quantized backends can show small vector differences compared to float backends; validate on representative prompts before migrating." short and customer-friendly.
courtney: another known issue: "During high load, requests can be routed to compatible model variants which may change output slightly; pin model versions for deterministic behavior."
ben: i'm going to run a grep for /embed vs /embeds and open redirects for any stale links in the staging redirect map. found two in the docs redirects.
sasha: reviewers: @ben + @courtney on #5115, @olivia on #5107, @sasha on #5102.
docbot: CI | docs-lint: passed ✅ (build 3282)
olivia: small wording nit: for embedding perf use "reduced latency for small inputs" instead of "tail latency". marketing prefers simple phrases.
courtney: noted, i'll use that phrasing in the whatsnew bullets.
noah: checklist before freeze: normalize curl params, update python streaming example, merge TS snippet, add known-issues block, run link sweep, consolidate whatsnew bullets.
sasha: timeline: final copy by 17:00 PT, freeze at 18:00 PT, deploy in the next window. flag blockers here.
cait: (replying in thread) adding an ops note: remember to reindex the docs search after deploy if we change anchors.
sasha: good call. adding reindex step to the deploy checklist. i'll post the final whatsnew diff here once PRs are merged and i'll ping product for the external release blurb. thanks all :thumbsup:
